Helioptile

Electric Normal

Kalos · Generation 6

Helioptile is an Electric/Normal-type Generator Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 6 kg. It evolves into Heliolisk. Its highest base stat is Speed (70), with a base stat total of 289.
